summary.text: Jason Patchett is a Republican Nevada Assembly member from District 19, appointed by the Clark County Commission on November 4, 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as attorney.

paragraphs.text: Patchett's education, as listed by Ballotpedia, includes a bachelor's degree from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, and a degree from the Sandra Day O'Connor College of Law at Arizona State University.
The Clark County Commission appointed him to Assembly District 19 on November 4, 2025, to replace Thaddeus Yurek, and he assumed office on November 13, 2025.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
